summary: "Data Activator" and "Reflex" are the SAME Fabric feature — the item type is Reflex and the fabio command group is `reflex`. Data Activator is the product name; a Reflex is the artifact that watches real-time data and fires actions (email/Teams) when conditions are met. Do NOT confuse it with Data Agent (natural-language Q&A over data, `data-agent`) or Operations Agent (AI-driven RTI monitoring, `operations-agent`).

meanings.context: Watch real-time data and trigger actions (the whole feature)
meanings.description: The Reflex item IS Data Activator. Create the item, then author monitoring rules that watch a KQL source (Fabric eventhouse or Azure Data Explorer) and send email/Teams alerts when a condition is met. In fabio this is the `reflex` command group (aliased `activator`/`data-activator`).
example_commands: fabio reflex create-rule --workspace $WS --id $REFLEX --name "High CPU" --kql "Metrics | project cpu, machineId" --eventhouse-id $KQLDB --column cpu --condition isGreaterThan --value 90 --recipients alice@contoso.com

meanings.description: A DIFFERENT item: an AI agent that monitors RTI signals and runs a playbook. Not a Reflex. Use when you want AI reasoning over operational data, not a deterministic condition->action rule.
Also DIFFERENT (and easily confused by name): a conversational agent that answers NL questions by querying data sources. Not a Reflex trigger.

default_action: "Data Activator", "Activator", "Reflex", "trigger", or "alert on data" -> the `reflex` command group (aliases: `activator`, `data-activator`). Author rules with `reflex create-rule`; manage them with `reflex list-rules`/`start-rule`/`stop-rule`/`delete-rule`/`rule-activations`. For AI monitoring use `operations-agent`; for NL Q&A use `data-agent`.
